# fixture (w3-dlc): the 三国演义 §9 shape — inherited state history that
# transfers the state only on machines that own La Resistance.
state = {
	id = 1
	name = "STATE_1"
	history = {
		owner = HAN
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "La Resistance" }
			transfer_state_to = COG
			add_core_of = COG
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dlc = "By Blood Alone" }
			}
			set_state_flag = no_bba
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					has_dlc = "Man the Guns"
					has_dlc = "No Step Back"
				}
			}
			add_building_construction = { type = naval_base level = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "la resistance" }
			set_state_flag = typo_never_runs
		}
	}
	provinces = { 1 2 3 }
}
